name: blank-cell-dimensions
source:
from openpyxl import Workbook
w=Workbook()
s=w.active
s.cell(12,4)
print(s.min_row,s.max_row,s.min_column,s.max_column,s.calculate_dimension())

s['D12']

name: none-clears-dimensions
source:
from openpyxl import Workbook
w=Workbook()
s=w.active
s['C9']=1
s['C9']=None
print(s.calculate_dimension())

name: empty-append
source:
from openpyxl import Workbook
w=Workbook()
s=w.active
s.append([])
s.append([None])
s.append([7])
print(s['A1'].value,s['A2'].value,s['A3'].value,s.max_row)

name: blank-gap-append
source:

w=Workbook()
s=w.active
s['A5']
s.append([7])
print(s['A1'].value,s['A6'].value,s.max_row)

name: deleted-cell-alias
source:
from openpyxl import Workbook
w=Workbook()
s=w.active
s['A1']=1
c=s['A1']
s.delete_rows(1)
s['A1']=2
print(c.value,s['A1'].value,c is s['A1'])

name: overwritten-move-alias
source:
from openpyxl import Workbook
w=Workbook()
s=w.active
s['A1']=1
s['A2']=2
c=s['A2']
s.move_range('A1',rows=1)
print(c.value,s['A2'].value,c is s['A2'])

name: copy-keeps-cell-independent
source:
from openpyxl import Workbook
w=Workbook()
s=w.active
s['A1']=1
c=w.copy_worksheet(s)
c['A1']=2
print(s['A1'].value,c['A1'].value)

name: row-iterator-lazy
source:
from openpyxl import Workbook
w=Workbook()
s=w.active
s.append([1])
r=s.iter_rows(values_only=True)
s['A1']=2
print(list(r))

name: append-tuple
source:
from openpyxl import Workbook
w=Workbook()
s=w.active
s.append((1,2))
print(list(s.values))

name: overwritten-move-alias-range
source:
from openpyxl import Workbook
w=Workbook()
s=w.active
s['A1']=1
s['A2']=2
c=s['A2']
s.move_range('A1:A1',rows=1)
print(c.value,s['A2'].value,c is s['A2'])

name: append-observation-order
source:
from openpyxl import Workbook
w=Workbook()
s=w.active
def row():
    yield 1
    print(s['A1'].value)
    yield 2
s.append(row())
print(s['A1'].value,s['B1'].value)

name: append-failed-generator-prefix
source:
from openpyxl import Workbook
w=Workbook()
s=w.active
def row():
    yield 1
    raise ValueError('stop')
try: s.append(row())
except ValueError: pass
print(s['A1'].value)

name: font-style-id
source:
from openpyxl import Workbook
w=Workbook()
s=w.active
from openpyxl.styles import Font
s['A1'].font=Font(bold=True)
s['A2'].font=Font(italic=True)
print(s['A1'].style_id==s['A2'].style_id,s['A1'].style_id>0)

name: iter-rows-is-iterator
